label: Peplink MAX BR2 LTE
description: Mobile router with LTE: 1x GE WAN, 4x GE LAN, 300 Mbps routing throughput, Wi-Fi.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: Ethernet WAN port 1 (GE), Number of Ethernet LAN port 4 (GE), Router Throughput 300 Mbps, Wi-Fi AP Yes. **300 Mbps is the ceiling for the whole router**, so a BR2 on a gigabit circuit forwards less than a third of it - the wired port count suggests far more headroom than the box has.
